summary: Aeries Technology filed an 8-K reporting a Letter Agreement with Sea Otter Trading to settle a $1,141,461 payment liability under a prepaid forward transaction. The company will pay $100,000 initially, then $75,000 monthly beginning September 15, 2026, at 7.5% annual interest. As collateral, Aeries will issue 145,183 Class A ordinary shares within 15 business days, with top-up provisions if market value falls below the outstanding liability. Sea Otter cannot sell the collateral while payments are current. The agreement restructures debt via equity collateral, not a traditional special situation; watch for default or dilution triggers.
